How can I pay with PayPal or a bank card?

The payment area loads the supplied official PayPal Hosted Buttons component. PayPal determines which payment methods are available for the buyer and transaction.

What to check before ordering

Confirm your quotation first, then review the item, currency, amount and recipient on PayPal. Card, Venmo or Pay Later options are not guaranteed. Website orders are not updated automatically after payment.
